fixed_integrity_gate.failed_requirement: The declaration required every numeric state_sequence to be unique after combining each period's event files.
fixed_integrity_gate.cause: state_sequence is a persisted-state version, not an event-journal primary key. Multiple distinct events can validly share one state sequence and server second, including ARC_SHADOW_ACTIVATION_SEALED plus EXTERNAL_CLOSE, ARC_CHECKPOINT plus ARC_REFUSED, and ARC_SHADOW_CURSOR_CHECKPOINT plus CLOSE.
fixed_integrity_gate.contract_defect: The unit froze an invalid uniqueness assumption. Because release-latency outcomes had already been opened when this was discovered, the declaration was not amended or reinterpreted.

non_authoritative_sensitivity.purpose: Record scale only; it cannot rescue or replace the failed frozen integrity contract.
non_authoritative_sensitivity.method: Preserve all distinct same-sequence events, sort by numeric state sequence with their observed file order, and apply the otherwise frozen exact-deadline release proxy.

fixed_threshold_comparison_only.period_breadth_required: at least two in each of at least three periods
fixed_threshold_comparison_only.period_breadth_observed: one in each of three periods

interpretation.formal: The frozen reconstruction contract is invalid, so this unit makes no release-window mechanism judgment and selects no receiver.
interpretation.bounded_observation: Even the disclosed non-authoritative sensitivity found only three exact-deadline capacity releases among 78 skips, well below every frozen density requirement. There is no economic reason to rescue this unit with a corrected key or longer window.
